## Status and write boundary

Every task identifies its real story path and epic-qualified ID. Copy Status from
the story; Must Have does not imply Ready. Sprint YAML is a derived view, with
disagreements recorded and synchronized only within authorization. Preserve
concurrent progress and document explicit carryover/defer decisions.
